answer: To blunt sybil swarms, gate every new identity through a capacity-bonded inlet: the agent posts a non-refundable stake sized to recent mining yield, then waits one epoch while peers watch its behavior. Only after that stake is accepted into the shared orchard of bonded workers does the network publish a live pulse of attested work credits; clones that skip the bond never receive credits, so mass-spawned identities stay economically barren.
